title: #317 Life Success
prompt: Some people believe that success in life comes from taking risks or chances. Others believe that success results from careful planning. What is your opinion about success?

promptSegments.text: Some people believe that success in life comes from taking risks or chances.
Others believe that success results from careful planning.
What is your opinion about success?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.
